steps.what: Install wet-wall blocks at the burned heights during framing.
Rough-in to the burned centre lines.

benefits.detail: Assumes 1.5 min per block measured and cut on site versus 0.4 min with a labelled, pre-cut part, at CAD 46.2/h loaded. Replace with your own time study.

benefits.value: 9.4% cut waste vs 10% typical order allowance
benefits.detail: Acucut 1D nester on this trade's 9 sticks: 1 boards, 3.66 m stock for 3.31 m of parts (bundle-window constrained runs add about 0.5 points). Conventional allowance 5 to 15% (BuildingScience). Difference about 0 bf, CAD 0 at CAD 700/MBF (estimate).

FMI puts rework at about 5% of construction spend and 48% of rework on poor communication or data. If labelled, sequenced, pre-checked parts prevent 15 to 30% of this trade's rework (estimate), callbacks fall by 0.75 to 1.50% of trade spend. On the NAHB reference home (US$428,215 build, 6.3% share = US$26,978) that is US$202 to US$405; not scaled to the 96 m2 sample.

cell_does: Cuts the wet-wall blocking with each fixture's centre line burned on it, so stub-outs land where the model says.
Lists every drain run and checks it against the framing (holes and notches per 9.23.5).
cell_cannot: Cut pipe. Drains on this slab-on-grade go below the slab; 1 drain needs a designer decision.
app: MEP view: drains and what each crosses.
Scan: block shows fixture and heights.
code: BC Plumbing Code (BCBC Division B Part 7), BCBC 9.23.5 notching and drilling
summary: Wet-wall blocking for every fixture cut and burned with the stub-out centre lines from the model, plus the drain list with joist checks.

drains.status: no framed floor below (slab-on-grade or unframed): drain below slab, no framing checks

stack.fix: reinforce plate with steel strap or re-frame (designer)

drains.status: no framed floor below (slab-on-grade or unframed): drain below slab, no framing checks

highlight: 9 wet-wall blocks for 4 fixtures, each burned with its stub-out centre line; 4 drains checked, 1 flagged for the designer.
routing: Acucut routing: the cell's nester groups this trade's parts by section and stock length, cuts them in bundle order (last-installed at the bottom), laser-burns the label, QR and every mark listed, and drops each bundle in its zone so the crew picks in install order.
